title: An overview of FAIR and qualitative matrices

videos.script: Lesson nine gave each risk a best guess and a range, and then used only the guesses. Today the ranges get to work. {{ranges}} The method has a name, FAIR, and a very simple engine underneath. Pretend ten thousand years go by. In each one, draw how often each risk happens and what each event costs, from the ranges you wrote. Add it up. {{simulate}} What comes out is not one number but a curve. The chance of losing more than a hundred thousand reais in a year. More than half a million. {{curve}} The owner of the clinics can look at that curve and say: this much risk, I can live with, and that much, I cannot. {{appetite}} Then you will meet the tool most companies use instead, the coloured five by five matrix, and see what it does to the same nine estimates. {{matrix}}
